description_for_human: Search and propose governed organizational facts (UniFact registry).
description_for_model: Use these actions to Fact Check UniFact before answering organization-specific questions. Prefer searchFacts or findRelevantFacts, then getFact for exact paths. Use upsertFact only to propose (registry_channel=proposed) after user confirmation. Never invent org truth.

functions.name: searchFacts
functions.description: Search UniFact for organizational facts matching a query. Prefer published results when answering.

reasoning.description: Searching UniFact for published org truth…
reasoning.instructions: Call searchFacts with q from the user question.

responding.instructions: Cite namespace/key. Label non-published channels as draft.

functions.name: findRelevantFacts
functions.description: Rank UniFact records for the current task intent (Fact Check).

reasoning.instructions: Pass q/intent/subject/scope; set published_only=true for production answers.

functions.name: getFact
functions.description: Get one UniFact by namespace and key. Optional as_of for point-in-time published truth.

reasoning.instructions: Use when the user or prior search named an exact namespace/key.

functions.name: upsertFact
functions.description: Propose or update a fact. Default to registry_channel=proposed. Confirm with the user before calling. Do not publish.

reasoning.instructions: Only after explicit user confirmation. Set created_by=uni-agent and source/evidence.
